rules.symptom: Branch ordering differs
rules.known_source_cause: Independent if statements versus else-if changes reachable blocks
rules.known_fix_pattern: Preserve DWARF scopes and independent guards; compare one change at a time

compiler_scope.acceptance: Hypothesis only; apply only when local evidence agrees and strict verification passes.

rules.symptom: Equivalent pointer/index uses a different register
rules.known_source_cause: Pointer and loop index may be folded when their relationship is provable
rules.known_fix_pattern: Match evidenced locals and lifetimes; do not add arbitrary volatile

rules.symptom: Argument setup differs at equal size
rules.known_source_cause: Source expression shape affects result register
rules.known_fix_pattern: Try an evidence-backed assignment expression or temporary; retain failed trials

rules.known_fix_pattern: Use DWARF lexical locals and scope before exploring flags

rules.known_fix_pattern: Compare before integer conversion only when evidence requires it

rules.known_fix_pattern: Match original load/increment order; record unsuccessful alternatives

rules.known_fix_pattern: Preserve the historical single cold block when corroborated by line/scopes

rules.symptom: LEA versus shift/add differs
rules.known_source_cause: Algebraically equivalent edge calculation has different shape
rules.known_fix_pattern: Use the recovered right-edge expression as a scoped example

rules.symptom: An equal-size loop differs only in adjacent byte/dword load ordering.
rules.known_source_cause: Operand order can affect the peeled first iteration differently from the loop backedge.
rules.known_fix_pattern: No proved fix. Do not repeat operand swap, preincrement loop, or expanded sum assignment for the recorded example; route to supervisor scheduling work.

rules.symptom: Adding a complete prototype can renumber GCC static symbols and swap adjacent independent register clears in an unrelated unresolved function.
rules.known_source_cause: Historical GCC declaration UID changes from a prototype-only edit.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Do not edit the affected function body to undo the change. The interface gate checks decoded independent clears, entry points, all other bytes and allocated contributions. Original matching remains byte-exact.

rules.symptom: Equal-sized function differs in scratch-register pushes or call argument setup, and an isolated peer-definition change alters its bytes without changing its body.
rules.known_source_cause: GCC 4.4.1 peep2_find_free_register retains search_ofs across successful scratch searches; earlier compiled functions can affect later scratch selection. Not every register mismatch is this cause.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Keep production flags and protected bodies. Supervisor runs compiler_probe.py and compares focused RTL passes. Resolve historical CU context once; do not keep rewriting the target or mask register bytes.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Diagnostic only. Strict original bytes and independently resolved operands still determine FUNCTION_MATCH.

rules.symptom: Current source definition order disagrees with unique original DWARF declaration lines.
rules.known_source_cause: Some reconstruction candidates were assembled in executable address order. GCC emission order does not necessarily equal source order.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Use the generated SOURCE_ORDER task only when complete definitions can move safely. Preserve all bodies and exact neighbors; reject new implicit declarations.

compiler_scope.acceptance: HISTORICAL_SOURCE_ORDER is a separate claim. Layout improvement alone is not FUNCTION_MATCH or CU_MATCH.

rules.symptom: Only conditional-branch opcodes differ after TEST/CMP; destinations and every other independently resolved byte agree.
rules.known_source_cause: A zero/nonzero guard can differ from an ordered signed comparison. After testing an integer against itself, JG/JLE distinguish positive/nonpositive while JNE/JE distinguish nonzero/zero.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Use the card's original condition and flags producer to inspect only the relevant source guard. Preserve other statements and run FAST; strict promotion still requires every byte.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Routing evidence only, never an equality mask.

rules.symptom: First differing instruction is a constant SUB ESP prologue allocation.
rules.known_source_cause: Not established by the allocation alone. Different local widths, spills, outgoing arguments, lifetimes or source expansion can change the frame.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Check the attached DWARF local-width evidence and calls before experimenting with register temporaries. Preserve x87 and historical flags; never change a frame size or padding to mask a source mismatch.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Decoded allocation is an observation, not an exact match or source-cause proof.

rules.symptom: A file-static to function-static declaration repair changes BSS symbol order and text operands even though expressions are unchanged.
rules.known_source_cause: On the locked main CU, moving face into main_menu_callback swaps face and number offsets. On fld_adspot with its locked flags, restoring localFilename scope preserves all emitted contributions.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Use the generated STATIC_SCOPE task and preservation gate. If it changes contributions, retain the symbol-offset differences, restore the source and route to a supervisor. Do not force placement or edit instruction expressions to compensate.

compiler_scope.flags: Per-CU locked configuration; observations do not establish a universal ordering rule.
compiler_scope.acceptance: Fresh independent owner proof and identical raw text/allocated contributions; no masked function acceptance.

rules.symptom: A bounded window contains exactly the same decoded MOV or register-clear instructions in a different order.
rules.known_source_cause: Adjacent assignment order or expression evaluation may affect instruction scheduling. The permutation alone does not establish the source cause or instruction independence.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Use candidate line mappings and the generated adjacent-assignment experiment when present. Verify the entire function; changes to other windows, operands or peeled iterations still fail acceptance.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Diagnostic only; no permutation normalization is admitted by the strict function oracle.

rules.symptom: An unchanged wrapper differs by three bytes because a final same-CU JMP uses short versus near encoding.
rules.known_source_cause: Moving complete definitions changes the distance between wrapper and callee; assembler branch relaxation changes final JMP width.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Do not edit the proven body. Require an exact independently resolved prefix, a unique identical historical callee, and proof that short encoding cannot reach in the long layout. Preserve raw DIFFER and explicit BODY_MATCH_LAYOUT_BLOCKED. Other neighbor or data mismatches still reject the task.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Narrow layout proof only; never FUNCTION_MATCH, OBJECT_MATCH or CU_MATCH.

rules.symptom: Instruction skeletons match, but aligned pointer operands reference different literal payloads.
rules.known_source_cause: Wrong filename format, file mode, default string, or formatting spaces can masquerade as relocation layout differences.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Use repair_literal_content when the card identifies unique explicit source tokens. It changes only those tokens. Equal content with unknown ownership stays blocked; original operand content is diagnostic evidence, not an independent relocation binding.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Fresh strict comparison, independently resolved relocations, neighbor preservation, ordinary link regression check and atomic publication.

rules.symptom: A correctly generated aggregate has a larger COFF COMMON allocation than its DWARF sizeof.
rules.known_source_cause: The locked compiler emits rounded COMMON storage; logical type size and allocation are different quantities.
rules.known_fix_pattern: Compile an independent declaration witness with the same locked flags and generated header. Verify logical type layout separately; allow only the witnessed target allocation change and preserve all other contributions. Never infer original BSS order from this witness.
